method: PROXY — no-PO line share, NOT a measured EDI flag
why_proxy: The billing extract has no order-type field. A manual order carries a customer purchase-order reference; an EDI order normally does not. The no-PO share is therefore a proxy for the automated share, not a count of EDI orders. Label it as a proxy wherever it is shown.

validation.note: If a distributor known to be on EDI does not show a high no-PO share, the proxy is weak and must not be quoted.
